context: Cypress config plus CI, where the right answers are specific option shapes. Predicted baseline failure: the agent sets a single `retries: 2`, which is precisely what the task rules out - it wants retries in the headless run and none in the interactive one, and Cypress expresses that as an object with `runMode` and `openMode` keys rather than a number. It is also likely to run the suite before the server is listening, or to insert a fixed sleep instead of polling the URL, and to upload artefacts without a condition so the upload is skipped on the failing run that needed it.

checklist.name: Retries differ between headless and interactive
checklist.description: `retries` is the object form distinguishing the two modes, e.g. `{ runMode: 2, openMode: 0 }`. A single number applied to both modes scores zero - it is the exact behaviour the task rejects, because it retries while a developer is writing the test and hides the breakage. Setting only `runMode` and omitting `openMode` scores at most half.

checklist.name: Failure artefacts are captured
checklist.description: The config enables screenshots on run failure and video (or explicitly documents video off with screenshots retained). Leaving both at defaults without stating them scores at most half; disabling both scores zero, since being unable to see the failure is the stated problem.

checklist.name: CI waits for the app before running specs
checklist.description: The workflow polls the URL until it responds - `wait-on`, the `cypress-io/github-action` `wait-on` input, or an equivalent readiness loop - before the specs run. A fixed `sleep` scores at most half: it is a guess that is either too short on a cold runner or wasted time. Starting the server and running Cypress with no readiness gate at all scores zero.

checklist.name: Artefacts survive a failing job
checklist.description: Screenshots and/or videos are uploaded with `if: always()` or `if: failure()`. An upload step with no condition placed after the test step scores zero - GitHub Actions skips it once the job has failed, which is the only time it matters.

checklist.name: Spec pattern and base URL configured
checklist.description: `specPattern` matches `cypress/e2e/**/*.cy.ts` and `baseUrl` is `http://localhost:3000`, so specs can call `cy.visit('/')`.

checklist.name: Suite runs headless in CI
checklist.description: The workflow invokes the headless run (`cypress run` directly or via `cypress-io/github-action`), not `cypress open`.

checklist.name: No paid Cypress Cloud dependency
checklist.description: MUST NOT require a Cypress Cloud record key - no `--record`, no `--parallel`, no `CYPRESS_RECORD_KEY`. The task states the team does not pay for it, so a workflow that cannot run without it scores zero.
